review_evidence: All 460 primary Rocq files lie under theories/ and constitute GeoCoq geometry developments: axioms, Tarski/Euclidean geometry, countermodels, coordinates, transformations, original Euclid proofs and supporting tactics.

Files named general_tactics/tactics_axioms are tightly integrated proof infrastructure inside the geometry theories; no bounded class was established whose removal could not hide useful formal statements or proof interfaces.
summary: Reviewed GeoCoq and retained all 460 primary Rocq files; this unit is a cohesive formal geometry library and no lossless source-local exclusion class was established.
